name: Shield Block (Combat)
body:
You can keep your shield on guard against attacks that might otherwise hit you when you are distracted.

Prerequisite: Dex 13, Dodge, Mobility, proficiency with shields

Benefit: When you have a shield equipped, you gain a +4 shield bonus to all attacks of opportunity made against you. You do not gain this bonus if you lose your Dexterity bonus to AC.
